seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Marion, Arkansas for 2026: 3 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Marion celebrates Christmas with a chamber-led season called Christmas in Marion, built around a drive-through light show, an evening parade and a party with carriage rides and Santa.
celebrates: The Marion Chamber of Commerce brands the season Christmas in Marion. It starts with a Shop Local campaign called Bright Stops, Local Shops and a Retail Open House, then moves to Light the Night, a 300 foot immersive drive-through light show at the sports complex from December 1 to December 25. The Parade of Lights Christmas Parade follows on the first Thursday of December, and Mingle and Jingle, with the Moms of Marion, brings carriage rides, snow machines, reindeer and nativity animals, crafts, vendors and Santa. The Marion Advertising and Promotion Commission funds the lights.
lastyear: We did not find a host recap of the 2025 season for Marion, so we have not described last year's parade or lights. What the chamber does say is that registration for the 2026 parade opened September 1, with entry forms handled at the chamber office on Military Road. This page is updated when the chamber or city shares photos or a recap.
facts: Light the Night is a 300 foot display, and the chamber says it is funded by the Marion Advertising and Promotion Commission. The chamber pairs it with Mingle and Jingle on December 5, when guests can walk through the lights instead of driving. Mingle and Jingle is also a partnership with a local parent group, Moms of Marion. The chamber describes the show as a way to kick your Christmas spirit into gear even if you are feeling a bit like Scrooge.
trains: Marion does not have its own Christmas train, but Memphis is the nearest big rail city, with two attractions that have pages on our site. The Memphis Railroad & Trolley Museum fills a ground floor suite of Central Station on South Main Street and tells the story of Memphis railroads and trolleys. MATA Trolley runs vintage and replica streetcars downtown. Both are in Memphis, Tennessee, if your family wants a train-themed day trip.

kidfact: Marion's Light the Night display is 300 feet long, and you can drive through it or, on December 5, walk through it.
faq: Christmas in Marion is the name the Marion Chamber of Commerce gives to its holiday season. It includes shop local days, Light the Night from December 1 to 25, the Parade of Lights Christmas Parade and Mingle and Jingle on December 5. The chamber's Christmas in Marion page lists each event and links to registration forms.
Is the Marion light show a drive-through?

Yes. The chamber describes Light the Night as a 300 foot immersive, drive-through light show with a park-and-watch option. It is set up at the sports complex on Complex Road. On December 5, during Mingle and Jingle, guests can also walk through the display instead of driving.
Can kids meet Santa in Marion?

The chamber's Mingle and Jingle party on December 5 includes a chance for a visit with Santa. It also lists carriage rides, snow machines, reindeer and nativity animals, Christmas crafts and holiday vendors. The party is held in partnership with the Moms of Marion and the Advertising and Promotion Commission.
How can my group be in the Marion Christmas Parade?

The chamber's parade page offers an online registration form and a printable PDF form. Completed paper forms can be emailed to the chamber or delivered to its office at 13 Military Road in Marion. The page also shows a map of the parade route.
Who runs Christmas events in Marion?

Most of the season is run by the Marion Chamber of Commerce, with the Marion Advertising and Promotion Commission funding Light the Night. The City of Marion lists the parade, the light show and Mingle and Jingle on its own calendar, so you can check dates on either site.
